Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to retrieve credible and authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica) to confirm the exact year of the Rhine crossing invasion (406 CE). Instead, it repeatedly relied on secondary sources like Wikipedia and DuckDuckGo search results without successfully locating a definitive Britannica citation for the event. This set the investigation on an inefficient path, as the Planner kept redirecting WebSurfer to repeat searches without resolving the task effectively. This initial failure to find a reliable source directly impacted the ability to provide a correct and well-cited solution to the real-world problem.
